tasks.AveragePagesPerDay: Calculate the average number of pages Solo needs to read per day over the remaining 4 days.
tasks.PagesAlreadyRead: Determine how many pages Solo has already read on Monday.
tasks.RemainingPages: Subtract the number of pages already read from the total pages to find out how many pages are left to read.
tasks.TotalPagesToRead: Calculate the total number of pages Solo needs to read from all textbooks.
